title: Systems Integration Engineer, Build Systems | Consumer Devices
description:
About the Team

The Systems Integration team is responsible for building the infrastructure, tooling, and validation systems that ensure our device software our device software is reliable, testable, and ready to ship. We design and maintain build systems, CI pipelines, automated test frameworks, and hardware-in-the-loop labs to enable rapid, safe product launches. Our work spans build systems, developer tools, systems integration, and cross-team collaboration to ensure developers can build reliably and ship with confidence.

About the Role

We are looking for an engineer to help evolve OpenAI’s Consumer Products build and continuous integration systems for a fast-growing engineering organization. This role sits at the intersection of developer productivity, build systems, distributed infrastructure, software quality, and on-device software. You will work on the systems that determine how quickly and confident engineers can move: Bazel-bazed builds, Buildkite pipelines, test coverage, remote caching and execution, CI observability, and tooling that helps engineers understand and fix failures quickly.

Our mission is to enable OpenAI to ship software running on consumer devices rapidly with a high bar for correctness, reliability, and safety. The best version of this work is invisible when it succeeds: builds are fast, tests are trusted, CI failures are understandable, and engineers can focus on shipping products instead of fighting infrastructure.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of four days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In This Role, You Will

- Own and evolve Bazel and yocto-based build and test workflows in a polyrepo environment

- Design and maintain Starlark rules, macros, toolchains, and integrations that make builds hermetic, reproducible, and easy for teams to adopt

- Improve CI performance and reliability across Buildkite pipelines, including queue time, build time, cache hit rates, retry behavior, and flake isolation.

- Build systems that reduce unnecessary CI work through affected-target detection, dependency graph analysis, test selection, caching, batching, and smarter scheduling

- Unify local and CI development workflows so engineers can reproduce CI behavior, debug build failures, and iterate quickly without learning every detail of the build stack

- Operate and optimize build infrastructure across Docker/OCI images, Kubernetes-based runners, cloud resources, and remote cache/execution systems

- Instrument build and CI systems with metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and analytics so we can measure speed, reliability, cost, and developer impact

- Partner directly with users to understand pain points, onboard projects, debug hard build issues, and remove systemic bottlenecks

- Use modern AI tools to pioneer novel CI failure analysis, flaky test debugging, PR triage, automated remediation, and developer-facing information

- Own the reliability of the systems you build, including participating in an on-call rotation for critical developer and factory infrastructure

Technologies Commonly Used In This Environment Include

- Bazel and Starlark for build and test workflows

- Buildkite for CI orchestration

- Docker and OCI images for build and runtime packaging

- Kubernetes for CI runners and infrastructure orchestration

- Python, Go, TypeScript, Rust, C++, and other languages in a large monorepo

- Terraform for infrastructure as code

- Remote caching, remote execution, artifact storage, and build telemetry systems

Minimum Qualifications:

- 5+ years of engineering experience, including significant experience building infrastructure and tooling for developers

- Hands-on experience with Bazel, Buck, Gradle, or similar build systems, and understand the trade offs of hermetic builds, dependency graphs, caching, sandboxing, and remote execution

You must already own or have access to a compatible camera with:

- A minimum recording resolution of 720p
Compatible camera examples include:

Mounting Equipment

Handheld selfie sticks, chest mounts, shoulder clips, and stationary tripods do not meet the required third-person perspective.

As Director of Technical Program Management for Driver Out at Wayve, you'll own the multi-year program that takes Wayve's autonomy technology and operationalises it - from our first eyes-off, driver-out demonstration through to a productised, scaled service on public roads. Driver Out is the underlying technology program behind Wayve's robotaxi ambitions: where the robotaxi pilots prove the product in different markets, you own the safety, systems, and delivery foundations that make driver-out real.

You'll lead an org-wide effort spanning driving-model performance and safety, behaviour validation, the safety case, system architecture, functional safety and V&V, vehicle hardware and software, remote assistance, and operations - turning a complex web of “must be true” conditions into a sequenced, credible plan. • Establish scalable practices: Governance, milestone and launch-readiness reviews, KPIs and dashboards, escalations, and risk-budget management.

• Represent Driver Out at the top: Report progress, risk, and readiness to the executive team, and steer the biggest calls.

title: Site Selection Lead
description:
About the Team

OpenAI is building the world’s most advanced AI infrastructure ecosystem. The Site Readiness & Development team owns the upstream diligence and development work required to convert powered-land opportunities into executable infrastructure options.

About the Role

The Site Selection Lead sets the site-selection strategy for powered-land and greenfield/brownfield opportunities. This role defines, with cross-functional partners, what makes a site attractive, executable, and scalable, then turns that shared rubric into portfolio choices and deployment plans.

Key Responsibilities

- Own the site-selection strategy across priority geographies, including market maps, pipeline segmentation, source refreshes, live-location tracking, and portfolio prioritization.

- Convene Power, Land, Development, Engineering, Construction, Environmental, Community, Commercial, Legal, and Finance partners to define the shared rubric for a high-quality site.

- Translate that rubric into clear screening criteria across power readiness, land control, timing, scale, cost, community risk, environmental constraints, AHJ path, budget, schedule, and counterparty credibility.

- Orchestrate Commercial, Legal, Finance, Power, and Development teams to shape exclusivity, initial terms, site-control strategy, funding assumptions, and the path to deployment before deeper commitment.

- Build a deployment plan for top candidates that identifies capacity, sequencing, capital implications, critical-path approvals, risks, owners, and stage-gate decisions.

- Lead conceptual site planning and test-fit screening using boundaries, map layers, buildings, substations, roads, parking, laydown, stormwater, utility corridors, acreage, and estimated load.

- Maintain a single decision-support view of pipeline stage, site health, power readiness, finance review, maps, project evidence, outstanding source data, owners, deadlines, and escalations.

- Present executive-ready advance, defer, or stop recommendations with clear trade-offs, resource asks, and next steps; hand qualified sites to the Development Lead with a complete screening record.

Qualifications

- 6+ years in site selection, infrastructure development, data center development, energy development, commercial real estate, or a related field.

- Strong strategic judgment on market intelligence, portfolio construction, site viability, counterparty credibility, and prioritization.

- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional organizations through ambiguous decisions and align technical, commercial, legal, and finance stakeholders.

- Commercial and financial fluency sufficient to connect site quality, deal terms, capital implications, schedule, and deployment risk.

- Experience building site funnels, screening frameworks, mapping or test-fit workflows, dashboards, and executive decision materials.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Backend Software Engineer - Python/Postgres [Remote / Global]
description:
Do you want to work for a mission-driven non-profit, writing software that will contribute to helping the livelihoods of millions of coffee farmers around the world? Enveritas is a 501(c)(3) non-profit and Y Combinator-backed startup looking to hire for our Engineering & Data Group. We are looking for a backend software engineer with a focus on python and PostgreSQL to join our EUDR engineering team on a remote/global, full-time basis. You can learn more about this job and our group at
We're a small team and every hire makes a large impact, so we're careful and thorough when it comes to hiring, but we are actively considering candidates and moving them through the process as quickly as we can.
About Our Engineering & Data Group
We are a quirky, talented, and humble group of about thirty people with diverse backgrounds, ranging from journalism to academia to international industry. We’re represented across the gender spectrum, with 36% of our Engineering and Data Group identifying as women and/or nonbinary. Several of us are parents, with more expecting.
Our group builds software to collect, analyze, and report data about coffee farmers’ conditions and practices. This large-scale data-collection effort requires many moving parts to work together, and we use technology to support that effort at every step of the process - from identifying coffee farms in satellite imagery, to coordinating survey edits across country teams, to detecting data anomalies in real-time that can be investigated while teams are still in the field. A core part of our work is in data aggregation and report generation, with insights ultimately being shared with roasters and other stakeholders on how to assist in improving the social, economic, and environmental conditions of smallholder farmers.
Our backend systems use Python and PostgreSQL/PostGIS, running in containerized services on AWS. We use GitHub and CI/CD, and Terraform for newer services.
What You’ll Be Doing
This role is part of our EUDR engineering team. Your work will focus on the backend systems that ingest customer-submitted farm lists, validate and transform those inputs, and run them against our deforestation detection model and geospatial datasets.
Your responsibilities will include:

•
Backend feature development and maintenance. Implement improvements to our EUDR backend services, refine geospatial workflows, and strengthen data checks and error handling.

•
Investigative problem-solving . When something doesn’t look right to our Support team, you will help trace through data, assumptions, and system behavior to understand what happened and how to fix it.

•
Working with ambiguous or evolving requirements. EUDR is a regulated space where guidance changes, and internal requests are sometimes incomplete. You’ll help clarify what’s needed and translate it into practical engineering work.

•
Adapting the system to regulatory updates . As the EU releases new FAQs or adjustments, you will help interpret their implications and adapt parts of the system to remain consistent and compliant.

•
General backend engineering . Python + PostgreSQL/PostGIS development, improving observability, contributing to CI/CD pipelines, and helping make the system more resilient over time.

Although the role is primarily development-focused, you will also be responsible for applying and maintaining Terraform-based changes in AWS for the services you work on.
Qualifications

• Strong ability to present and explain complex ideas clearly to non-technical colleagues.

• Demonstrated ability to apply design patterns for creating modular and efficient software, with the ability to teach others how to solve architectural problems.

• Extensive experience with Python, including developing applications and complex data processing tasks. Familiarity with Django or Flask.

• Advanced experience with PostgreSQL, including query optimization, joins, stored procedures, and performance tuning.

• Practical experience with Linux

title: Senior Software Engineer - SRE
locationText: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
description:
When the Tarr Steps, a footbridge assembled of heavy stones in Exmoor National Park in England, washed away in a flood in 1942, the Royal Engineers rebuilt it. Then it washed away again in 1952. So the Royal Engineers heaved in more stones: on and on, like a Sisyphean lesson in absurdity.

Of course, they do this because the Tarr Steps are a historical monument, believed to be built during the Bronze Age. Modern bridge building looks a lot different and generally requires less upkeep. While we appreciate the charm of ancient things, Mercury is engineering the future of banking*. "Quaint" and "archaic" are not values we seek in our systems. Rebooting a tumbling server and hoping a flood of requests doesn't wash it away can be an emergency tactic, but we actively seek out durable solutions over monotonous ops work. You'll bring this ethos and teach others how to live it too.

Up to this point, the Stability team at Mercury has primarily built platform-level constructs that product teams adopt. However, those teams are asking for us to work more closely with them to mature their implementations and practices. We are creating an SRE team that will rotate through product teams. You will understand the team's domain, identify opportunities for improvements in reliability/observability/performance/preparedness and create self-reinforcing, virtuous cycles.

As part of this role, you will:

• Embed with product teams, helping them improve their operational maturity by setting up and refining practices around on-call, monitoring, alerting, and run books

• Run regular game day exercises with product teams, helping them feel more prepared to investigate and quickly remediate incidents

• Jump into application code written in Haskell & TypeScript and implement reliability techniques such as retries, better error handling, better logging, circuit breaking, etc

• Steer SLOs towards meaningful customer outcomes that product teams are accountable for. Those SLOs become a strong signal for whether the product is working as intended

• Champion reliability practices through design document and code reviews

• Identify observability gaps that hinder debugging, incident response, and business intelligence and help close those

• Advocate for longer-term improvements that non-product engineering teams can drive

• Participate in the product team's on-call rotation while embedding or as part of a more general engineering rotation, helping us improve processes and how we learn from incidents

The ideal candidate for the role:

• Has past Site Reliability Engineering or DevOps experience

• Has measurable examples of influencing an organization towards greater reliability

• Has significant experience with PostgreSQL

• Has authored and operated Temporal workflows

• Has experience with observability platforms like Grafana or Honeycomb

• Has familiarity with OpenTelemetry

If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at personal-demo.mercury.com .

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence agents. Agents can generate code and tests in seconds, but they can also produce passing test suites for software that doesn't work as intended. As a Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll own the technical thesis for closing that validation gap and build the early proof yourself. You'll rethink what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy enough that teams choose to adopt it.

• Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy.

• Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions.

• Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language.

• Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, fed straight back into the platform.

What you’ll do

• Own the technical thesis for how GitLab validates software when an agent is the author, and turn it into an architecture the team can build against.

• Prototype the hard parts by building early versions of feedback mechanisms that catch the gap between passing tests and working software, proving what works before the team scales it.

• Develop approaches for GitLab's primary stacks, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, under one shared definition of "trusted," while allowing the right technique to differ by language.

• Design the mid-loop feedback an agent needs to self-correct toward working software rather than green assertions, and build the systems that deliver it.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to adopt these approaches, measure adoption, engineer trust, and validation quality, and use those findings to improve the platform.

• Set technical direction the team can build on, review designs, and help teammates grow their technical judgment.

What you’ll bring

• Deep, current, hands-on experience building real software with artificial intelligence agents, ideally across more than one language, and a clear understanding of why agent output can pass tests yet fail in production.

• A strong point of view on the validation gap and concrete ideas for closing it, backed by approaches you've built or tried.

We're looking for a Systems Integration Engineer to own the hardware and software decisions that make a vehicle build actually work - from compute and sensor architecture down to harness routing, sensor tuning, and drive-by-wire (DBW) integration. Autonomy & drive-by-wire coordination

Field operations & site standup

- Travel onsite - domestically and internationally, including extended stays - to lead vehicle builds, hardware installs, and demo prep in person.

Cross-functional engineering collaboration

- Work daily across hardware, embedded, and autonomy software teams to resolve integration issues and keep builds moving.

- Communicate fluidly between deep technical detail and higher-level engineering summaries when working with adjacent teams.

What we're looking for

Required

- 2+ years of experience in systems/integration engineering, ideally on automotive, robotics, defense, or autonomy programs.

- Working knowledge of vehicle hardware integration - harnessing, sensor/compute mounting, and hardware architecture - sufficient to make and defend build decisions.

title: Sales Finance Manager

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

THE ROLE

We're hiring a CPG Sales Finance Manager to own the accruals, deduction, dispute resolution experience for our customers. Disputes sit at the center of what Confido automates for CPG brands, and this role is the connective tissue between our Implementation, Customer Success, and Product teams - making sure customers actually resolve disputes faster and more accurately on our platform, not just process them.

You'll work hands-on with customer data to investigate and resolve deduction disputes, help new customers get their dispute workflows configured correctly during onboarding, and be the expert voice that tells Product where the platform's dispute logic needs to evolve.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Product Feedback Loop

- Partner with product and engineering team to inform roadmap priorities, validate designs, and ensure we're solving real CPG demand planning challenges

- Synthesize customer feedback and market intelligence into actionable product insights

- Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them to optimize workflows, solve challenges, and maximize platform value

- Collaborate with sales & marketing teams on key go-to-market activities including discovery calls, content generation and educational materials, running webinars, etc.

Implementation Support

- Partner with the Implementation team during customer onboarding to configure dispute workflows

- Help new customers migrate and clean up historical dispute and deduction data as part of go-live

- Train customer teams on how to manage disputes within the Confido platform

Customer Success

- Act as the dispute-resolution expert within the broader CS relationship, jumping into health checks or escalations when disputes are a pain point

- Help CS managers explain dispute trends, aging, and recovery performance to customers in QBRs

- Flag at-risk accounts where unresolved disputes signal a deeper adoption or workflow issue

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years of hands-on demand planning experience at CPG brands, including direct responsibility for forecast generation, demand-supply collaboration, and S&OP processes

- 3+ years of experience in deductions, trade promotion finance, accounts receivable, or a similar CPG/retail-adjacent operations role

- Comfortable working in the details of retailer/distributor documentation and reconciling discrepancies with precision

- Strong cross-functional communicator - equally comfortable talking to a customer, an implementation lead, and a product manager

- Process-oriented with a sharp eye for patterns; you notice when something's recurring and want to fix the root cause, not just the instance

- Experience with CPG trade, deductions, or AR systems is a strong plus

- Willingness to work at our NYC Headquarters 5 days a week

description:
about us
At ACCURE , we empower batteries and those who use them.  
Batteries are a key element of our clean energy and mobility future. ACCURE makes batteries safe, reliable, and sustainable through the power of the cloud. Using our highly scalable monitoring and optimization platform, we turn operational data from large-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) into insights our customers act on - safety, performance, lifetime, and commercial value. This is why we are currently looking for a student to work on the following topic in form of a master thesis:

MCP as a Growth Lever for Industrial Software Platforms

Model Context Protocol (MCP) opens a new interface layer between AI assistants and industrial software platforms. The field is young and the patterns are still forming - a good moment to shape them. For a platform provider like us, the question is: where does this create product and market opportunities, and how big are they? This thesis is suitable for students of a business- or tech-related field with a genuine interest in MCP and where it might take an industrial software platform.
your role
and YOUR THESIS
You can shape the thesis along one of two lenses - or your own angle:

•
Commercial lens: Architect the value proposition and go-to-market for MCP-enabled platform offerings - who buys it, why, at what price, and through which channel.

•
Technical lens: Build a working MCP prototype on top of our platform, designed against real customer workflows and evaluated for security, latency, and scale.

•
Working with the platform: Get access to our platform, team, and customers, with close supervision and real stakes - your work feeds into live decisions.

•
Customer exposure: Where it helps, engage directly with customers and partners through calls, interviews, and workshops to ground your work in real-world needs.

•
Shaping the future: Help define an emerging interface layer for industrial software, contributing to how AI assistants and platforms work together.

your skills

Experience: Currently pursuing a master’s in a business- or tech-related field - less about the exact degree, more about your interest in MCP.

•
Analytical mindset: Self-directed and structured, curious about the intersection of product and market, able to extract meaningful conclusions.

•
Technical affinity: Interest in AI assistants, software products, and how industrial platforms are used in the field; hands-on prototyping experience is a plus for the technical lens.

•
Working style: You bring initiative, reliability, and strong organizational skills, manage tasks independently, and enjoy taking ownership.

•
Languages: Strong communication skills in English; the thesis is written in English. German is a plus.

our offer

•
Real stakes: Your work feeds into live decisions and helps shape product and market direction for an emerging technology.

•

Never stop learning: Learn all about batteries, industrial software, and MCP from your colleagues.

A job that shapes the future and turns our planet greener one battery at a time.

title: Staff / Principal Product Manager
description:
Inkitt is building the Disney of the 21st Century, standing at the forefront of technology and entertainment. Leveraging AI and predictive algorithms, Inkitt discovers unknown stories and turns them into blockbuster hits, producing a new $1M ebook every 7 days and selling directly to consumers through its Inkitt Galatea app. Bestsellers are then translated onto the screen through Inkitt CandyJar, the #1 US-based microdrama platform with billions of episodes streamed to date. Inkitt has become the 11th most bestseller-generating publisher in the world, boasting a 40x higher hit-rate than traditional publishers. Backed by some of the top VC’s such as: Khosla, Kleiner Perkins, and NEA Ventures, our recent expansion into Ironblood, the first AI Native streaming platform for action and adventure, is only the beginning of our journey to becoming the next-gen entertainment powerhouse.
 
 
Which product you'll own
We run four consumer products and we are hiring product managers for all of them.
Galatea - serialized fiction, millions of readers, coins and subscription
CandyJar - the #1 US-based microdrama platform, billions of episodes streamed
Ironblood - our new AI-native streaming platform for action and adventure
Inkitt - the writing and discovery platform underneath all of it
We decide which one you own at the point you start, not at the point you apply. When you join, we look at where the largest metric gap is across the portfolio and put you there. As the team grows, areas get reshuffled - people move to where the biggest problem is.
We say this plainly because at this level it is the most common reason a hire does not work out. If you need to own one named domain indefinitely, or your value depends on a particular surface staying yours, this will frustrate you.
 
How We Work - please read this part carefully
This role works differently from most senior product jobs, and the difference is the single biggest predictor of whether someone succeeds here.
Ali, our founder and CEO, sets company priorities. You own the ideas. You will spend part of every day researching competitors, the industry and our users to generate new feature ideas, and you will keep a live Top 3 list of the highest-impact ideas for your area - a new idea only enters by beating one already on it.
You pitch on a single slide with an impact calculation attached. Anything over a week of engineering needs a methodical business case demonstrating ROI. Ali rejects ideas that will not move the number enough to justify the build, and he does so often. The loop is pitch, get rejected, sharpen, re-pitch - continuously, alongside delivery.
Once approved, you own execution outright, including release and A/B ramping. Four weeks after launch, every feature is reviewed against the impact you predicted before you built it. You cannot inflate a forecast to win approval, because the forecast becomes your scorecard.
Your performance is measured on two things: how often you beat your own Top 3, and the realised impact of what you ship.
This is not a role where a roadmap is handed to you and you are judged on delivering it. If that is the job you are looking for, this will frustrate you, and we would rather you knew now.

At Inkitt, we strive to build a company culture and provide employment opportunities based on diversity and inclusion. We believe every author should have an equal opportunity to succeed, as should our team members. As a growing team from 20+ countries, we welcome everyone to apply. 
 
We look forward to hearing from you!
 
Check out our Careers Blog 💼
Follow us on Instagram & LinkedIn! 💻

title: Director of Legal Engineering, Dubai
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Let's get the tricky part out of the way. Legal Engineering does not fit neatly into a traditional box. It combines legal practice, product fluency, enterprise change, commercial judgement and client leadership.

As Director of Legal Engineering, Dubai, your mission is to establish Legal Engineering as the commercial and delivery engine for the Middle East, anchored in Dubai. The region is currently served from our European hubs, alongside an installed base that already includes some of the most significant firms and in-house teams in the Gulf. Your job is to turn that into a local function: the craft bar, the team, the manager layer and the operating system that keeps it connected to Legora globally.

title: Product Manager
description:
Fully remote role!
Who we are
PartsTech is an automotive technology company. We help repair shops find the right parts fast. One search shows you live inventory and wholesale pricing from all of a shop’s parts suppliers.
Repair shops rely on us to provide them with access to the necessary parts inventory to keep vehicles moving through their bays as quickly as possible.
How we run things
We always start with our product vision: we make it fast and easy for auto repair shops to find the right parts across all of their suppliers with one search.
As a Product Manager you will report to the VP of Product and you will be a part of the product team which currently consists of product management, technical product management, product design, and user research. You will own at least one major area of the product or overall ecosystem. You’re responsible for identifying problems worth solving, prioritizing, contributing to the roadmap, and owning the execution and delivery.
We already have great product designers. We are not looking for someone who wants to own design, but instead contributes where applicable to the design thinking process.You will be paired with a product designer where together you will help shape the future of the product. Our engineering team is awesome. Whatever we come up with they push to make it happen (just check out our product and you’ll see).
Where we’re located
We have strong roots in Massachusetts and Connecticut, but we’re a global team. You can expect to be working with team members throughout the U.S. and overseas.
What we’re looking for
You have a startup mentality. You are completely comfortable in an environment that moves quickly and easily pivots as new product-changing information becomes available. This doesn’t mean we’re changing the roadmap every two weeks, but it does mean we avoid the sunk cost fallacy (we don’t move forward with bad decisions just because we already put time into something). If you don’t meet everything on this list, but feel you are still a competitive candidate for the role, then apply.

• Comfortable working in an OKR environment

• You’re really good at asking why and truly understanding the problem

• You don’t just deliver features, you solve problems that translate into great features

• Experience in delivering incremental value, measuring, then modifying as needed until the desired result is achieved

• Ideally an example of sunsetting at least one feature

• Experience working with data and knowing the difference between being data informed vs data driven (we are more of a data informed environment)

• Experience in SaaS and E-commerce is preferred

• Experience with consumer products or B2B products that have delivered an experience expected of a consumer product

• Experience with e-commerce search and results (or different search with same level of complexity)

• Very familiar with design thinking and can give clear examples of how it is applied

• Has participated in or directly led design sprints

• Works directly with customers weekly to help uncover problems worth solving

• Understands how to correctly work with and utilize a user researcher

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
PartsTech is a next-generation ordering platform designed to help professional technicians save time and reduce the hassle associated with wholesale automotive parts procurement. With a single search, a technician can instantaneously locate, evaluate and order parts from both local suppliers as well as national warehouses. PartsTech provides the latest product descriptions, images, and schematics directly from manufacturers, giving technicians the best possible information when purchasing parts.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Repository)
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

Senior Software Engineer (Repository)

The role

If you’re excited by the idea of building the trusted front door to secure open source software, this role is for you. Chainguard’s Repository team owns the customer-facing infrastructure that serves libraries today and is laying the foundation for a unified repository experience across more artifact types over time, including containers and APKs.

We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help lead the architecture and implementation of the Repository team’s core systems: package registries, APIs, and production services that securely serve artifacts to customers at high scale and high reliability.

This is an infrastructure-heavy backend role. It sits at the intersection of software engineering and production infrastructure: writing Go services, building and operating customer-facing systems, improving reliability and performance, and shaping how Chainguard Repository expands beyond Libraries into a broader artifact platform.

This is an early, high-impact area for the company. 

What you'll do

• Own the technical direction for key parts of Chainguard Repository, including customer-facing registries, APIs, and serving systems that make Chainguard artifacts easy to consume securely and reliably.

• Design, build, and operate high-availability backend services in Go that serve libraries today and help lay the foundation for containers, images, and APK repositories over time.

• Lead work on scalability, reliability, observability, and load testing for production systems that customers depend on directly.

• Drive technical decisions around repository architecture, service boundaries, and the operational patterns needed to run artifact-serving infrastructure at scale.

• Partner closely with engineers across Chainguard to create a cohesive repository experience and unlock support for more artifact types over time.

What we're looking for

• 5+ years of experience building and operating production backend or infrastructure systems, with clear evidence of senior level ownership.

• Strong Go experience, or deep backend systems experience with the ability to ramp quickly in Go.

• Experience building or operating customer-facing infrastructure such as package registries, artifact repositories, APIs, developer platforms, or other high-scale serving systems.

• Experience deploying and managing services in production, with strong judgment around reliability, observability, performance, and operational tradeoffs.

• Comfort working across application and infrastructure layers, including service development, cloud infrastructure, and infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform.

• Strong systems instincts and curiosity: you proactively identify problems, chase them down, and improve the platform before issues become bottlenecks for customers or internal teams.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially in a remote environment   If you use AI in your application materials, please include the phrase “bonfires are my jam” naturally in your experience.

Nice to have

• Experience with package registries, artifact serving, repository products, or adjacent systems such as Docker registries, GitLab package services, Artifactory, Nexus, or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with software supply chain security concepts such as provenance, SBOM

title: Claims Counsel, Management Liability
description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.
Brown & Brown is seeking a Claims Counsel, Management Liability to join our growing team!
    
The Claims Counsel's primary function is to independently manage a portfolio of complex Management Liability claims, including Directors & Officers Liability, Employment Practices Liability, Fiduciary Liability, Crime, and related financial lines claims involving private companies and nonprofit organizations.

The successful candidate will work closely with underwriting, carrier partners, brokers, insureds, and defense counsel to deliver superior claims outcomes while supporting the strategic growth of Nexus's Management Liability portfolio. This role requires deep technical expertise, sound business judgment, strong relationship management skills, and the ability to balance legal, coverage, financial, customer service, and portfolio considerations in claims decision-making.
How You Will Contribute:   
Claims Management and Coverage Analysis

• Independently manage a portfolio of complex and high-severity Management Liability claims.

• Analyze policy coverage and prepare reservation of rights letters, coverage position letters, and declination letters.

• Conduct detailed factual, legal, financial, and coverage analyses to evaluate liability, damages, and exposure.

• Establish and maintain appropriate claim reserves within delegated authority and seek additional authority when required.

• Evaluate settlement opportunities and participate in mediations, settlement conferences, and other dispute resolution proceedings.

• Exercise sound judgment on complex coverage and litigation issues while maintaining consistency with claims handling guidelines and business objectives.

Litigation Management

• Direct litigation involving insured organizations and individual directors, officers, trustees, and executives.

• Retain, manage, and evaluate defense counsel and coverage counsel.

• Review and approve litigation budgets, monitor legal spend, and negotiate alternative fee arrangements when appropriate.

• Develop and implement effective litigation and resolution strategies.

Portfolio and Business Partnership

• Serve as a trusted advisor to underwriting regarding claims trends, emerging risks, coverage issues, and portfolio performance.

• Partner with underwriting teams to identify opportunities for product enhancement and improved risk selection.

• Analyze claims trends and portfolio data to identify emerging exposures and provide actionable business insights.

• Prepare timely, accurate reporting for carrier partners and reinsurers and participate in stewardship discussions and portfolio reviews.

• Demonstrate a balanced approach that considers legal exposure, coverage intent, customer experience, broker relationships, and portfolio impact when making claims decisions.

Broker and Market Engagement

• Build and maintain strong relationships with retail and wholesale brokers, insureds, carrier partners, and defense counsel.

• Participate in broker stewardship meetings, claim reviews, underwriting roundtables, and market-facing presentations as needed.

• Represent Nexus professionally in interactions with brokers, insureds, carrier partners, counsel, and industry stakeholders.

Leadership and Operational Excellence

• Serve as a technical resource and mentor to less experienced claims professionals.

• Participate in claims audits, quality reviews, training initiatives, and process improvement projects.

• Support strategic initiatives designed to enhance claims operations and service delivery.

• Embrace claims technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, consistency, and claim outcomes.

• Ensure compliance with delegated authority agreements, carrier guidelines, service standards, and applicable regulations.
Skills & Experience to be Successful:  

• Juris Doctor (JD)

description:
Job Title: Division 8 Estimator
Location: South Africa (Remote)
Job Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: US Hours (4pm-12am SAST)
Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)
A detail oriented and experienced Division 8 Estimator is sought to join a growing team specializing in doors, frames, hardware, and locking systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing accurate project estimates involving construction documents, coordinating with vendors and suppliers, and supporting bid submissions for commercial projects. The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, construction estimating experience, and knowledge of Division 8 products and specifications.
Key Responsibilities

• Review architectural drawings, specifications, and project documents for Division 8 scope requirements

• Prepare accurate cost estimates for doors, frames, hardware, and locking systems

• Perform quantity takeoffs and material calculations

• Coordinate with suppliers and vendors to obtain pricing and product information

• Analyze bid documents, addenda, and project requirements

• Prepare and submit proposals and bid packages within deadlines

• Collaborate with project managers, sales teams, and clients regarding project requirements

• Maintain organized estimating records and project documentation

• Identify value engineering opportunities and cost-saving solutions

• Ensure estimates align with company standards, project specifications, and industry regulations

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree (B.A./B.S.) highly preferred

• Minimum of 2 years of estimating experience in construction, doors and hardware, or related industry

• Knowledge of Division 8 products including doors, frames, hardware, and access control systems

• Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings and construction specifications

• Experience with estimating software and Microsoft Office Suite

• Strong mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• Excellent communication and time management abilities

• Strong organizational and coordination skills

• Strong communication skills with contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders

• Ability to manage multiple software platforms and communicate directly with contractors throughout the estimating process

• Ability to multitask across multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines

• Capable of working across multiple product categories and workstreams, rather than focusing on a single area of estimating

• Ability to manage multiple bids and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

• Experience working with commercial construction projects preferred

description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

 

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me ,  Do the Right Thing , and  Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a talented Mobile Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain high-performance native iOS applications that power core user experiences. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve technical challenges at scale, write resilient code, and help maintain high engineering standards.

What You'll Be Doing

• Build & Scale Native Mobile Apps: Design, develop, and maintain modular, reliable native mobile features (iOS) used by millions of global users.

• Architect Core Systems: Drive technical decision-making on mobile architecture, API design, performance optimization, and offline/network resiliency.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Product Management, Design, and Backend Engineering to translate complex user and commercial requirements into intuitive, reliable mobile experiences.

• Ensure Quality & Rigor: Write clean, testable, and maintainable code while maintaining high engineering standards for code reviews, testing, security, and monitoring.

• Integrate AI Workflows: Apply AI coding tools actively in your workflow-not only for code generation, but also to build and maintain repeatable personal AI development workflows.

• Modernize Engineering Tooling: Leverage modern development tools, automated CI/CD pipelines, and productivity workflows to maintain rapid iteration speeds.

 

What We Look For In You

• Solid software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building, shipping, or maintaining production native iOS applications 

• Strong understanding of mobile system design, clean architecture, memory management, testing, and performance tuning.

• Ability to actively apply AI coding tools in your workflow and continuously optimize personal engineering productivity.

• Problem-solving mindset with the ability to take ownership of end-to-end features and drive execution independently.

 

Nice-To-Haves

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for mobile delivery (e.g., Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Xcode Cloud).

• Familiarity with analytics, feature flagging, and experimentation/A/B testing frameworks.

• Experience maintaining or contributing to shared mobile frameworks or design systems.

• Proficiency in speaking, reading and writing in both English and Mandarin to collaborate effectively with global and cross-functional team members.

 

Perks & Benefits

•
Competitive total compensation package

•
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•
Various team building programs and company events

•
Wellness and meal allowances

•
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

More that we love to tell you along the process!

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. • Full administrative support.

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
